<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 1in"><B>Item 3.02.</B></TD><TD><B>Unregistered Sale of Equity Securities.</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">As of October 23, 2026, pursuant to a capital drawdown notice delivered
under a subscription agreement between Third Point Private Capital Income Fund (the &ldquo;Fund&rdquo;) and Delticus Opportunities Fund
LLC (&ldquo;Delticus&rdquo;), an affiliate of the Fund&rsquo;s investment adviser, Third Point Private Capital LLC, under  which Delticus committed to purchase, through drawdowns, up to $15,000,000 in common shares of
beneficial interest of the Fund (the &ldquo;Common Subscription Agreement&rdquo;), the Fund issued and sold Shares in an unregistered
offering to Delticus. The final number of Shares sold was determined on November 3, 2026, at an initial offering price of $25.00 per Share,
as set forth in the table below:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom">
    <TD STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid">Date of Unregistered Sale</TD><TD STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-bottom: 1pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid">Number of Class S Shares</TD><TD STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-bottom: 1pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>Consideration<SUP>(1)</SUP></B></P></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom; background-color: rgb(204,238,255)">
    <TD STYLE="width: 62%; font-size: 10pt">October 23, 2026 (number of shares finalized on November 3, 2026)</TD><TD STYLE="width: 2%; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 17%; font-size: 10pt; text-align: center">160,000</TD><TD STYLE="width: 2%; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 17%; font-size: 10pt; text-align: center">$4,000,000</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><SUP>(1)</SUP> No underwriting discounts or commissions were paid in
connection with the sale of such Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The offer and sale of the Shares were not registered
under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &ldquo;Securities Act&rdquo;), in reliance upon the exemptions from registration provided
by Section 4(a)(2) thereof and Regulation D promulgated thereunder. The Fund relied, in part, on representations made by Delticus in the
Common Subscription Agreement that Delticus was an &ldquo;accredited investor&rdquo; (as defined in Regulation D under the Securities
Act).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Fund and Delticus have also entered into a
related subscription agreement pursuant to which Delticus has committed to purchase, through drawdowns, up to $225,000,000 of preferred
shares of beneficial interest of the Fund (the &ldquo;Seed Share Subscription Agreement&rdquo;, and together with the Common Subscription
Agreement, the &ldquo;Subscription Agreements&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The foregoing description of the
Subscription Agreements is only a summary and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the form of Subscription Agreement and
the form of Seed Share Subscription Agreement, filed as Exhibits 10.5 and 10.6, respectively, to the Fund&rsquo;s Registration
Statement on Form 10 and incorporated herein by reference.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>
